blurb: Offers weekly dance classes for ages 3 to adult including ballet, tap, jazz, contemporary, and pointe. Has a Pre-Professional Ballet Academy by audition for dancers grade 6 and above. Adult classes available for beginners and intermediate dancers.
extraNote: $30 registration fee per dancer and first month's tuition due at registration, both non-refundable · No refunds or make-ups for missed classes · 5% discount for second class and above per student · $30 late fee if account not current by 15th of the month · May payment is final for Fall/Spring season; delinquent accounts may prohibit recital participation · Studio at 2255 McCollum Parkway, NW Suite 100, Kennesaw, GA 30144 · Fall classes begin August 1st, 2026
